title: 2001 HMMT February Calculus Problem 2
statement: The polynomial \(3 x^{5}-250 x^{3}+735 x\) is interesting because it has the maximum possible number of relative extrema and points of inflection at integer lattice points for a quintic polynomial. What is the sum of the \(x\)-coordinates of these points?

solutions.text: The first derivative is \(15 x^{4}-750 x^{2}+735\), whose roots (which give the relative extrema) sum to \(750 / 15=50\). The second derivative is \(60 x^{3}-1500 x\), whose roots (which give the points of inflection) sum to \(1500 / 60=25\), for a grand total of 75 .
